1. LAUNCH WILL TAKE PLACE BTN 0530Z AND 0700Z. 
ACTUAL LAUNCH WINDOW IS EXP TO BE 15MIN. 
2. ARR/DEP AT THIRUVANANTHAPURAM AP MAY BE DLA 
DRG RANGE ACT. ARR MAY BE REQUIRED BY ATC TO 
HOLD CLR OF DNG AREA. DEP MAY BE DLA ON GND. 
MAX ANTICIPATED DLA FOR ARR AND DEP IS AROUND 30MIN. 
3. RNAV SIDS & STARS FOR THIRUVANANTHAPURAM AP SHALL 
NOT BE AVBL DRG THE NOTAM PERIOD. 
4. ATS RTE Q12, Q13, W15, W43, W91, R457, P570, L899, 
UL425, N640, V22, V23, V24, V25, V26, V27, V28 AND V29 
ARE AFFECTED DUE TO THE RANGE ACT.

DOTAT DCT BIKOK.
